headline: Keep today short and easy after a five-hour night
summary: Friday’s rest reduced acute load and recovery time is nearly complete. However, sleep was only 5h 09m and Training Readiness is low at 37. If alert and symptom-free, run 30–40 minutes very easy; otherwise walk or rest.

recommendation.title: Run 30–40 minutes very easy only if alert
details: Aim for roughly 5–6 km on a flat or gently rolling route at RPE 2.
Keep the whole run conversational; no tempo, intervals, strides, hills or fast finish.
Do not extend it into a long run or add make-up mileage.
recommendation.alternative: Walk easily for 20–30 minutes or take full rest if sleepy, sore, unwell or reluctant to run.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, illness, unusual fatigue or dizziness. Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness.

signals.interpretation: Recent hard-work recovery is nearly complete, supporting only light movement—not quality training.

signals.label: Load normalized
signals.interpretation: Friday’s rest lowered acute load, so a short easy run is reasonable if alertness is good.

caveats: Device measurements and classifications are Garmin data; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
Garmin’s recovery timer estimates readiness for another hard effort; it is not a ban on all movement.
Current alertness, symptoms and medical advice override device scores.
